_comment: Prompts for the quick-chat stickers. {name} {look} {he} {his} {him} are filled per character. Order = CHAT_MSGS in app/game/[id].tsx.
setup: Use the attached portrait of my character "{name}". Draw exactly this character: same face, {look}, same comedy caricature manga style as the portrait. One chat sticker, square, the character from the waist up with a thick white die-cut outline around the whole silhouette, real transparent background. Very exaggerated manga expression and pose; manga effects allowed (sweat drops, sparkles, speed lines, steam, hearts, question marks, confetti). Absolutely no text, no letters, no words, no speech bubbles. The sticker:

reactions.text: clapping enthusiastically, wide delighted eyes, sparkles around {him}.
exasperated, both palms raised saying "stop", vein mark on {his} forehead, little steam puffs.
hands pressed together in thanks, small grateful bow, warm smile, tiny hearts.
jaw dropped in disbelief, eyes popping, a four-leaf clover floating next to {him}.
impatiently tapping {his} wristwatch and pointing forward, speed lines behind {him}.
embarrassed, scratching the back of {his} head, big sweat drop, blushing cheeks.
celebrating with a big grin and a thumbs up, confetti bursting around {him}.
hand on {his} chin, one eye squinting, looking up, question marks floating above {his} head.
